description:
Fair Deal Property, Your Trusted Experts for Residential Property Sales

Are delighted to present for sale this handsomely upgraded four-bedroom semi-detached residence, located in one of Tuam town’s most convenient residential developments.

Overlooking an open green area and boasting an impressive floor area of 114 square metres, Number 115 Cois na Habhainn is a spacious family home that has been thoughtfully upgraded throughout. From the beautifully remodelled interiors to the carefully considered outdoor spaces, evidence of the attention to detail is everywhere to be seen.

On arrival, a widened driveway provides comfortable parking for two cars. A new energy-efficient front door, featuring a five-point locking system and an attractive curved glazed archway, sets the tone for the accommodation that lies within.

Inside, a bright and spacious entrance hallway leads to a generously proportioned living room, featuring premium wood flooring and a feature fireplace with an oak surround. An inset stove, fully plumbed into the heating system, adds warmth and character to this inviting space.

Double doors lead through to a completely remodelled kitchen and dining area. Upgraded and expanded kitchen units wrap around the room, providing an exceptional amount of storage, while granite worktops offer generous preparation space and a premium finish. A professional Rangemaster cooker further enhances this impressive kitchen.

A well-proportioned utility room with additional storage, along with a guest WC, completes the ground-floor accommodation.

The outdoor space has received the same thoughtful attention. A most attractive decorative stone patio, framed by artificial grass and complemented by a pergola, provides a welcoming setting for outdoor dining, entertaining or simply relaxing. A recently fitted steel shed incorporates a workshop and additional storage space, adding further practicality to this beautifully presented home.

Upstairs, an attractive landing leads to four bedrooms, comprising two doubles and two singles, along with the family bathroom.

The delightfully presented master bedroom is flooded with natural light and features built-in wardrobes and a well-proportioned en suite. A further double bedroom also benefits from built-in wardrobes, while two beautifully presented single bedrooms complete the sleeping accommodation. A well-appointed family bathroom completes the accommodation. 

If you are looking for a turnkey, fully upgraded and spacious four-bedroom family residence in a highly convenient location, representing excellent value, we highly recommend that you look no further than Number 115 Cois na Habhainn. With its generous accommodation, quality finishes and beautifully remodelled outdoor space, this impressive home is certain to exceed your expectations.

If this sounds like you, we would be delighted to hear from you and show you around. Call Fair Deal Property today to arrange your viewing.
